facts.fact: The KIX Africa 19 policy brief on the knowledge café of 22 July 2025 recommends mandating individual student tracking 'as piloted in Mozambique'; it names no system, platform, school count or level for the pilot.

systems.platform: Microsoft .NET and MS SQL Server 2008 R2, exporting to Excel pivot tables
systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Culture (Head of Statistics)
systems.tiers: fed by censuses covering primary, secondary, adult education and school mapping, on physical questionnaires; holds data aggregated by class, subject and gender, not individual student records
described only as piloted in Mozambique

systems.system: planned fully digital platform for real-time entry
systems.platform: DHIS2 being piloted for offline dashboards; SOFIA (School Open-source Feedback and Improvement App) named as piloted in The Gambia and Mozambique
systems.tiers: planned; not stated who would enter what

note: StatEduc is described by the ministry's Head of Statistics as census-fed and aggregate, so it is class census and gives no fact; the brief states it was conceived in 1976, automated in 1981 and updated in 2021 and 2022 to comply with EMIS Law 18/2018. The planned real-time platform is not described per learner and is left unclassified. The one fact rests on a passing phrase in the recommendations.
